title: Frame generation is not credit-gated
summary: Frame generation (single and bulk start/end frame jobs) does not read or deduct user_credits. Credit references exist only in checkout.ts, videoGenerationService.ts (insufficient-credit throw) and userCreditsService.ts; charging happens at Stage 11 confirm-render. Frame cost is shown as a progress/cost bar but generation is not blocked by balance.
notes: Absence claim established by grep over backend/src; no runtime check. Relevant to WD-IDEA-UX-347.

title: Dashboard current scene is the first unfinished scene, not last-worked
summary: The project list derives currentSceneNumber/currentSceneStage/currentSceneStatus from scenes.find(status !== video_complete), i.e. the first unfinished scene in fetched order. No field records the last scene or stage the user worked on, and no route writes such a field.
notes: Searched lastWorked, last_worked, last_opened, lastOpened in src and backend/src: no hits. Relevant to WD-IDEA-UX-337, UX-344, UX-345.

title: Only app-level keyboard shortcut is Ctrl/Cmd+B for the sidebar
summary: The only window keydown handler that performs an app action is the shadcn sidebar toggle bound to Ctrl/Cmd+B. Stage-jump, save, regenerate and generate shortcuts are absent. Other keydown listeners are local (slider comparison Escape, content-access Escape, tag input keys).
notes: Searched ctrlKey, metaKey, onKeyDown, keydown, useHotkeys, hotkey in src and backend/src (excluding tests). ScreenplayToolbar.tsx:15-32 lists shortcut labels for screenplay formatting; its handler wiring was not traced. Relevant to WD-IDEA-UX-156.

title: Regeneration reference toggle has five labels and defaults to off
summary: The use-current-image-as-reference control appears in at least five places with different labels: 'Use current image as reference' (Switch, no tooltip, FramePanel), 'Use as ref' (Switch plus Info tooltip, Stage 8 VisualStateEditorPanel), 'Use as ref' (EnhancedUploadModal), 'Use as reference image' (FrameUploadModal), and 'Use as ref' (TransformationEventCard). FramePanel state useCurrentAsRef initializes to false. The control is rendered only when an image exists.
notes: Visibility gating: FramePanel requires frame?.imageUrl; Stage 8 requires selectedAsset.image_key_url. Relevant to WD-IDEA-UX-282, UX-296, UX-297, UX-281.

title: App default theme is dark with system option
summary: The root ThemeProvider sets attribute class, defaultTheme dark and enableSystem, so the app opens in dark theme unless the user selects otherwise. The global sidebar renders a ThemeToggle.
notes: Persistence of the chosen theme is delegated to the theme library; not traced. Relevant to WD-IDEA-UX-357.

title: Stage 2 retroactive-revise control is unreachable and only toasts
summary: Stage 2 renders a retroactive-revise button only inside a block gated on local state isOutdated, which is initialized false and never set true anywhere in the file. The handler only shows the toast 'Retroactive revision triggered' and sets isOutdated false. No backend call is made.
notes: Verified by grepping setIsOutdated in Stage2Treatment.tsx (only the handler). Relevant to WD-IDEA-UX-068.

title: Phase A lock inserts a new locked version on every call with no already-locked check
summary: The Phase A lock route checks only that the predecessor stage is locked or skipped, then inserts a new stage_states row with status locked and version+1, copying the latest content. The current row's status is logged but never tested, so repeated locks of a locked stage each add a version row. Status stays locked; row count grows.
notes: Checked by awk over lines 297-412 for status references: only predecessor status and log fields. Relevant to WD-IDEA-UX-026.
